# wowMD

wowMD is a local-first Markdown reading product family with a free Chrome extension for GitHub Markdown and a Pro webapp for local Markdown files.

Official site: https://wowmd.app/

## What wowMD does

Free Chrome Extension:

- Adds a Better view entry point to complex public GitHub README and Markdown pages.
- Opens with an outline so readers can understand document structure first.
- Provides section folding, code rendering, table scrolling, and cleaner Markdown rendering.
- Offers a local full-screen reader for focused reading.
- Appears only when a page is complex enough to benefit from structured reading.

wowMD Pro Webapp:

- Opens local `.md` and `.markdown` files in the browser.
- Supports a focused reading workspace with outline navigation and folding.
- Adds local highlights and notes.
- Exports clean offline HTML reading copies.
- Keeps document processing local-first.

## Site structure

- `/` is a minimal gateway page for choosing the right product.
- `/extension.html` explains the free Chrome extension.
- `/pro.html` explains wowMD Pro.
- `/app/` is the actual webapp.
- `/privacy.html`, `/terms.html`, and `/feedback.html` provide policy and support pages.

## Current scope

Supported:

- Public GitHub repository README pages.
- Public GitHub `.md` file pages.
- Public GitHub `.markdown` file pages.
- Right-side reader panel and local full-screen reader.
- Local Markdown files in wowMD Pro.
- Local annotations and HTML export in wowMD Pro.

Not currently supported:

- Private repositories.
- Non-GitHub websites.
- GitHub Issues, Pull Requests, Wiki pages, or other GitHub surfaces.
- AI summaries, translation, cloud sync, accounts, or settings.
- Private repository import or extension-to-webapp document transfer.

## Privacy

wowMD is privacy-first:

- No personal information collection.
- No document upload to third-party services.
- No AI or cloud analysis in the current beta.
- No Raw Markdown or GitHub API request before the user clicks Better view.
- Local reading remains available without an account.

## Status

Extension version: Beta v0.1.0

Pricing: the Chrome extension is free. wowMD Pro may start with free early access while pricing is finalized, with a planned low-cost one-time lifetime license.
